name: text starts with the query (prefix tier)
word order does not matter (sos tometo vs tometo sos, word-prefix tier)
query matches somewhere inside the text, not at a word start (substring tier)
a one-character-missing typo still matches (typo-tolerant tier)
two combined phonetic substitutions (sha+ssa vs sa+sa) only resolve at the phonetic tier, too far apart for typo-tolerance
